item: GO #7 (owner: 'one knob at a time'; director astro-imaging-45; worker this session) — a MEASUREMENT: is the members' night-dependent entry-side softness in the PHOTONS (the single raws) or added by the CHAIN for that night? Pre-registered in datasets/aug06/experiments.jsonl (line 102) before any raw was converted; the RESULT entry is line 103; this record carries every number.

preregistration_verbatim.status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE ANY RAW IS CONVERTED OR MEASURED. Owner-directed ('one knob at a time'); director astro-imaging-45; worker this session. A MEASUREMENT: no build, no product; the last attribution step before a knob.
preregistration_verbatim.question: The members' entry-side softness at the corpus's left band is NIGHT-dominated under one lens (GO #6: aug14 members 3.1-3.4 px / 0.66-0.75 vs july31 members 2.2-2.7 / 0.80-0.98 at the same entry-side columns). Is it in the PHOTONS (present in the single raw frames of that night) or does the CHAIN add it for that night (the per-set lens model + darktable warp, or the member registration)? Photons -> the knob is member selection/weighting by measured shape at the compose; chain -> the lens model/warp for that night.
preregistration_verbatim.method: the corner_work single-raw state (datasets/aug06/corner_work/mechanism_and_specs.json: 'debayered, UNcalibrated, UNwarped, UNregistered, UNstacked — one exposure'): 3 raws per set in capture order (first, middle, last of the culled set) for 6 sets = 18 raws, converted with the frame-QA conversion (Siril `convert c -debayer`, set16bits, no calibration) into sessions/<night>/work/rawshape/<set>/; then scripts/qa/star_stations.py's own station geometry and Siril script (its stations_for + measure functions called with a KEPT work dir so the per-star lists survive): --angle-deg 0, --offsets=1200,1800,2400, --radius=400 -> centre, along+-1200/1800/2400 (the sensor x-axis) and perp+-1200/1800/2400 (y-axis), 800-px boxes, gate 'setfindstar reset -roundness=0.05 -sigma=0.5 -relax=on'. Every raw of every night is measured at the SAME sensor positions by construction.
preregistration_verbatim.statistics: per raw and station: star_stations' own all-star medians (majFWHM = FWHMx median, roundness = FWHMy/FWHMx median, its linear angle median) AND, for the like-for-like comparison with GO #6's member readings, the top-30-by-amplitude median of (FWHMx+FWHMy)/2 and of min/max roundness from the same list (shape_at_sky's statistic), plus the top-30 e-weighted axial-mean major-axis angle (the GO #5 method) vs the x-axis (= the drift axis on the sensor; the RA direction is +x on every member, and no step of the chain mirrors x: Siril convert, savetif32, darktable's warp, convert, register). Per set: the median over its 3 raws.
preregistration_verbatim.members_reference_GO6: the sets' members' entry-side readings from left_band_member_attribution.json (top-30, 800-px boxes at the band's sky positions, member dx from centre 1519-2477 px): paired to the raw stations by nearest dx (dx < 2100 -> along+1800, dx >= 2100 -> along+2400), median per set per station

rules_pre_registered.PHOTONS: at along+1800/+2400 the soft night's raws (aug14/set-04, set-05) read FWHM within the stacking/resampling floor band of their own members' entry-side readings at matched sensor x — member minus raw within [-0.04, +0.45] px (floor 0.16-0.25 per GO #5's single-frame-vs-stack ledger, +-0.20) — AND the by-night ORDERING of the raws (aug14 > aug09 > aug06 >= july31) reproduces the members' ordering
rules_pre_registered.CHAIN: aug14's raws read like july31's raws at +1800/+2400 (within 0.15 px / 0.03 roundness) while their members differ by >= 0.4 px — the night term enters after the raw
rules_pre_registered.controls: exit-side stations (along-1200/-1800/-2400) and the centre: all nights' raws agree within 0.15 px / 0.03 (the lens's clean side); perp stations reported
rules_pre_registered.field_constant: the in-exposure trail (2.5 s x the drift, ~0.78 px predicted on the raw grid) is the same on every night and cancels in the comparison

preregistration_verbatim.no_destructive_steps: raws read only (symlinked into the scratch dir; nothing written beside them); converted frames, .ssf, logs and lists under sessions/<night>/work/rawshape/ (gitignored); the tracked outputs are this ledger's two entries and the corpus record

instrument: Siril `convert c -debayer` (set16bits, no calibration — the frame-QA conversion) on 3 raws per set staged as symlinks; scripts/qa/star_stations.py's own image_dims / measure functions (Siril crop + findstar, gate 'setfindstar reset -roundness=0.05 -sigma=0.5 -relax=on') called with a KEPT work dir so the per-star lists survive, on the tool's own box arithmetic (stations_for) restricted to the stations that fit the 6064x4040 frame: centre, along+-1200/1800/2400 (x-axis), perp+-1200 (perp+-1800/2400 do not fit the 4040-px height and are skipped, reported); 800-px boxes; per station the tool's all-star medians AND the top-30-by-amplitude median of (FWHMx+FWHMy)/2 and min/max roundness (shape_at_sky's statistic, = GO #6's member numbers), the e-weighted axial-mean major-axis angle vs the x-axis; per set the median over its 3 raws

reading: PHOTONS. The night term is in the single raw frames — debayered, uncalibrated, unwarped, unregistered, one 2.5 s exposure — at the same sensor stations on every night: at along+2400 aug14/set-04 reads 2.942 px / 0.535 and aug14/set-05 3.027 / 0.530 (median of 3 raws, top-30) against july31/set-01 2.178 / 0.804 — a 0.76-0.85 px raw difference, the members' difference being 0.89-0.95 px (GO #6); at along+1800 2.785-2.868 / 0.57-0.59 vs 2.032 / 0.799. The PHOTONS rule holds: member minus raw at +1800/+2400 lies in the stacking/resampling floor band [-0.04, +0.45] on 11 of the 12 set x station pairings (aug14/set-04 +0.395/+0.372, aug14/set-05 +0.412/+0.342, aug06/set-02 +0.392/+0.292, july31/set-01 +0.286/+0.242, july31/set-03 +0.438/+0.272; the one miss aug09/set-05 +1800 at +0.468 overshoots by 0.018 with n=5 members), the roundness gain member-over-raw is a uniform +0.11..+0.16 (stacking rounds the trailed single frame, as the GO #5 lineage measured), and the by-night ordering of the raws at +2400 reproduces the members' ordering SET BY SET: aug14/set-05 > aug14/set-04 > aug09/set-05 > july31/set-03 > aug06/set-02 > july31/set-01 in both (at +1800 the same to the night). The CHAIN rule fails on every pairing: no aug14 raw reads like a july31 raw at +1800/+2400 (dFWHM +0.49..+0.85 px, droundness -0.12..-0.27) while the members differ by 0.56-0.96 px — the night term is already in the raw, the chain adds the same floor to every night. THE PRE-REGISTERED CONTROL EXPECTATION FAILED, and that is a finding: the exit side and the centre are NOT night-invariant. Across the six sets the raws spread 0.39-0.42 px FWHM / 0.15-0.16 roundness at along-2400/-1800 (aug14 2.53-2.64 / 0.73-0.75 vs july31/set-01 2.19-2.22 / 0.87-0.89), 0.32 px at -1200 and 0.40 px at the centre (aug14 2.09-2.15, july31/set-01 1.99, aug09 1.95, july31/set-03 1.79, aug06 1.75) — aug14 is softer EVERYWHERE on the sensor, not only on the entry side. The entry-side EXCESS over the exit side (along+2400 minus along-2400) is itself night-dependent: aug14 +0.41 / +0.45 px, aug09 +0.29, july31/set-03 +0.12, aug06 +0.10, july31/set-01 -0.01 — so the 'lens asymmetric aberration' on the entry side is not a fixed property of the lens: it is absent on july31/set-01's raws and largest on aug14's, under one lens at one focal length. Not measured here: what varied by night (focus position, temperature, tilt/decentring state, seeing) — the state that sets it is upstream of every processing knob. ANGLES: at +1800/+2400 the top-30 major axis is 2-6 deg from the sensor x-axis (the drift axis) on every night, with ellipticity e 0.49-0.56 on aug14, 0.42-0.49 on aug09, 0.30-0.40 on aug06/july31-set-03 and 0.21-0.22 on july31/set-01; at the centre 4-57 deg off with e 0.12-0.24 (the in-exposure trail plus whatever the night adds, near-round); on the exit side 1-14 deg off with e 0.13-0.31. The in-exposure trail (2.5 s x the drift, ~0.78 px on the raw grid) is a field-constant on every night and cancels in every comparison above. WHAT THIS PICKS: the knob is member selection / weighting by MEASURED shape at the compose (the photons of aug14 — and, to a lesser degree, aug09 — carry the softness into every member of those nights; no lens-model or warp change for a night can remove what the raw already holds). It also re-reads GO #5's entry-side span dependence on aug06/set-01: a night whose raws are asymmetric at +2400 (aug06 +0.10 excess) shows the span-averaging term there; july31/set-01, symmetric in the raw, would be predicted not to — untested.
premises_untested: orientation: +x on the raw = +x on the member = +RA (the entry side): no step of the chain mirrors x (Siril convert, savetif32, darktable's warp, convert, register) and the data carry the signature (the large-e, drift-aligned side is +x on every raw); a vertical flip between raw and member would not change this; not verified by a solve of a raw

matched sensor x: the members' GO #6 readings sit at member dx 1519-2477 from THEIR canvas centre (the undistorted, framing=min'd geometry, 5.5-5.8k wide) and are paired to the raw stations at +1800/+2400 from the 6064-px raw centre by nearest dx — a few hundred px of mismatch on a steep PSF gradient; the ordering test is robust to it, the +-0.20 band less so
three raws per set (first/middle/last) stand for the set; the within-set spread is 0.05-0.20 px at +2400 (per_raw)
the gate differs from shape_at_sky's (-roundness=0.05 -sigma=0.5 vs 0.10 -maxR=1.0): the top-30 brightest are insensitive to the faint-end gate; not measured
the floor band [-0.04, +0.45] was taken from the GO #5 lineage's single-frame-vs-stack figures (+0.16-0.25) +-0.20; aug09/set-05 at +1800 sits 0.018 outside it
what varies by night (focus, temperature, tilt, seeing) is not measured; the corner_work single-raw state is the same, that record's numbers are on aug06 only
